preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(row, list) for row in matrix) and all(len(row) == len(matrix[0]) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: The input matrix is a non-empty list of lists where each row has the same length (C columns).

preconditions.expression: all(all(cell == 0 or cell == 1 for cell in row) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the matrix contains only 0 or 1.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= row_num < len(matrix) for row_num in return_value)
postconditions.description: All returned row numbers are valid 0-based indices of the input matrix.

postconditions.expression: all(any(matrix[i] == matrix[j] for j in range(len(matrix)) if i != j) for i in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each returned row number corresponds to a row that is a duplicate of at least one other row in the matrix.

postconditions.expression: all(i not in return_value or not any(matrix[i] == matrix[j] for j in range(len(matrix)) if i != j) for i in range(len(matrix)))
postconditions.description: No row number is included in the result unless it is a duplicate of another row.
